canada_ca.title: Proposed Renewal of the Environmental Performance Agreements Concerning Air Pollutants from Base Metals Facilities
canada_ca.summary:
Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) is soliciting your feedback on the proposed renewal of the environmental performance agreements concerning air pollutants from base metals facilities (2018 agreements) which expired on December 31, 2025. 
The comments received during this consultation period will be considered before the agreements are finalized and signed by the parties.

canada_ca.summary: Health Canada has conducted an evaluation of available relevant scientific information related to the aspects of concern for human health. Based on the evaluation of the aspects of concern, Health Canada is proposing for public consultation, the continued registration of ethalfluralin products intended for blending with fertilizers registered for sale and use in Canada.

canada_ca.title: Share your thoughts: Proposed risk management options for red pine scale in Canada
canada_ca.summary: The movement of host pine plants and pine products, particularly red pine logs with bark originating from infested areas, represents a potential pathway for the introduction of red pine scale into Canada. To help prevent its introduction and protect Canadian forests, we are considering the regulation of red pine scale.

canada_ca.title: Public Engagement toward a National Water Security Strategy
canada_ca.summary:
The Canada Water Agency is leading efforts to develop Canada’s first National
Water Security Strategy to help protect freshwater ecosystems and secure
water for communities and the economy, now and for future generations. The
Agency is inviting Canadians to share their views to inform the development of
Canada’s first National Water Security Strategy.
